krump.sLK: Krump FRONT STOMP: lift the front knee high, then drive the foot hard down onto the floor just in front (stomping on the opponent's foot), body hunched forward aggressively.
krump.jH: Krump STOMP in the air: knees pulled up high, then both feet drive straight down together to stomp, arms flared out.
krump.chestPop: Krump TEARING: hunched over, both hands claw and grab the chest while tension builds, then both arms rip outward and apart as if tearing the chest open; chest thrust out, head back, fierce face.
krump.jumpStomp: Krump JUMP STOMP: crouch, leap up high with both knees pulled up to the chest, then LAND by slamming BOTH FEET flat into the floor: knees deeply bent, body hunched low and forward, both arms flared down and out to the sides, fierce face. The landing frames are a heavy two-foot stomp, NOT a punch.

waacker.sHK: Waacking TWIRL KICK: spin once with both arms extended straight out (a twirl), then extend the front leg high in a long elegant line.
waacker.poseWave: Waacking WHACK into a POSE: the arm whips fast like a whip crack, then freezes in a dramatic old-Hollywood pose: one hand behind the head, the other arm extended straight forward, chin up, confident expression.
waacker.twirl: Waacking TWIRL: spinning turns with both arms extended straight out like a T, finishing in a pose with one hand behind the head.

hiphopper.idle: Hip-hop DOWN BOUNCE groove: on every beat the knees and chest drop heavily, then come back up; shoulders loose, a big relaxed bounce.
hiphopper.walkF: Walking forward with a heavy hip-hop down bounce on every step, shoulders loose.
hiphopper.walkB: Walking backward with a heavy hip-hop down bounce on every step, shoulders loose.
hiphopper.crissCross: KRIS KROSS jump: two hops forward; in the air the legs open, and each landing crosses the legs (one foot crossed in front of the other) with a heavy bounce.
hiphopper.dougie: The DOUGIE: lean the upper body back, then sweep one hand up over the head as if brushing the hair back, cool expression.

locker.sLP: Locking POINT: the hand starts at the OPPOSITE shoulder, then shoots out straight to point forward with one finger and holds, big smile.
locker.scoobot: Locking SCOOBOT: in a muscle-man up-lock (both arms raised above the shoulders, elbows bent), turn around while doing alternating Scoo-B-Doo kicks, ending in a lock (bent forward, arms forming a circle downward).
locker.scoobyHop: Locking SCOOBY HOP: from a muscle-man up-lock pose (arms raised above the shoulders), hop up and kick forward in the air, then land.

househead.walkF: Walking forward with continuous house JACKING: the torso ripples forward and back on every beat while the feet shuffle.
househead.walkB: Walking backward with continuous house JACKING: the torso ripples forward and back on every beat while the feet shuffle.
househead.jH: House DIVE in the air: body stretched horizontally, diving forward with both arms reaching forward and the legs trailing behind (lofting dolphin dive).
househead.looseLegs: House LOOSE LEGS: hopping lightly on one foot while the other leg swings loose and floppy, then stamping that foot down onto the floor just in front (stepping on the opponent's feet); alternate legs.
househead.shuffle: House SHUFFLE: quick shuffle steps sliding the feet out and back, then a hop that brings the heel chopping down from above.

popper.walkB: Popping BACKSLIDE (moonwalk): one foot flat sliding backward along the floor while the other foot stays in front with its heel raised on the toes, alternating; upper body calm and still.
popper.backdash: Popping BACKSLIDE (moonwalk) sliding backward quickly: one foot flat sliding back, the other on its toes, alternating.
popper.popShot: Popping HIT: the arm pops with a sharp muscle contraction as it extends forward, the whole arm locked and vibrating at the end of the pop.

bboy.footworkRush: B-boy FOOTWORK on the floor: hands planted, body low to the ground, six-step and CC footwork with the legs circling around, finishing with a kickout (both legs kicked straight out).
